umroh-saas.bodyHtml:
Gambaran Umum

UmrohApps adalah platform SaaS manajemen operasional dan booking engine modern yang dirancang khusus untuk memfasilitasi biro travel perjalanan Umroh dan Haji. Platform ini menggantikan sistem pencatatan manual dan spreadsheet yang rentan selisih dengan ekosistem digital terpadu—mencakup pengelolaan kuota paket, manifes penerbangan, pembagian kamar hotel di Makkah dan Madinah, verifikasi berkas jamaah, hingga pelunasan pembayaran.

Melalui digitalisasi alur kerja, agensi travel dapat meningkatkan kapasitas pendaftaran jamaah berkali-kali lipat tanpa khawatir terjadi tumpang tindih kuota maupun kehilangan berkas fisik.

Permasalahan

Biro perjalanan umroh menghadapi siklus operasional yang kompleks: berkas paspor jamaah yang sering terlambat diverifikasi, koordinasi jamaah yang berantakan di grup chat, kerumitan mengatur rooming list hotel secara mendadak di Arab Saudi, serta lambatnya rekonsiliasi setoran dana jamaah.

Tantangan utama yang dihadapi meliputi:

  • Sulitnya memantau ketersediaan kuota paket dan harga early-bird secara real-time antar kantor cabang
  • Proses pengumpulan berkas paspor, buku vaksin meningitis, dan foto visa yang lambat serta rawan tercecer
  • Rekonsiliasi pembayaran cicilan jamaah yang memakan waktu dan berisiko salah catat

Tujuan Proyek

Tujuan utama dari pengembangan platform UmrohApps adalah:

  1. Membangun arsitektur multi-tenant SaaS yang mendukung kantor pusat, kantor cabang, dan jaringan agen resmi
  2. Menyediakan portal pendaftaran mandiri jamaah yang responsif, mudah dipahami, dan cepat diakses melalui ponsel
  3. Mengotomasi pembuatan manifes keberangkatan yang sesuai standar SISKOPATUH Kementerian Agama RI
  4. Mengintegrasikan notifikasi status pembayaran dan reminder manasik secara langsung melalui WhatsApp otomatis

Pendekatan Kerja

Proyek ini dikembangkan melalui pendekatan terstruktur dan iteratif dengan melibatkan para pengelola biro umroh dan pembimbing ibadah (muthowif).

Riset Pengguna

Mewawancarai pimpinan biro travel dan staf operasional untuk memetakan alur pendaftaran, manasik, hingga keberangkatan dan kepulangan jamaah.

Desain Antarmuka

Merancang alur formulir bertahap yang ramah bagi jamaah usia lanjut serta matriks visual alokasi kamar hotel (Double, Triple, Quad).

Pengembangan Sistem

Membangun fondasi web aplikasi performa tinggi dengan enkripsi dokumen paspor, generator manifes PDF, dan webhook payment gateway.

Uji Coba Lapangan

Menguji skenario booking serentak pada musim puncak umroh Ramadhan untuk memastikan seat locking akurat tanpa ada double booking.

Solusi yang Dihadirkan

UmrohApps menghadirkan rangkaian solusi terpadu untuk efisiensi biro travel:

  • Katalog paket umroh interaktif lengkap dengan penghitung kuota real-time dan skema cicilan pembayaran
  • Portal jamaah mandiri untuk upload paspor, cek status penerbitan visa, dan jadwal manasik
  • Manajemen hotel dan bus satu-klik untuk pembagian kamar jamaah secara akurat
  • Integrasi pembayaran digital instan via QRIS dan Virtual Account dengan kuitansi otomatis

Kesimpulan

UmrohApps sukses merevolusi tata kelola administrasi travel umroh menjadi serba otomatis dan transparan. Agensi pengguna mencatatkan penghematan waktu verifikasi dokumen hingga 70% dan meningkatkan kepercayaan calon jamaah berkat kepastian jadwal dan transparansi pembayaran.

umroh-saas.bodyHtml_en:
Overview

UmrohApps is a specialized SaaS management and booking ecosystem designed specifically for Umroh and Hajj travel agencies. The platform centralizes pilgrim records, package configurations, flight and hotel allocations, and financial reconciliation into a unified, high-performance web application.

By modernizing legacy spreadsheet-based operations into automated digital workflows, agencies can scale their passenger volume with zero operational friction.

Problem

Pilgrimage agencies encounter unique operational headaches: manual passport verification, scattered WhatsApp communication, complicated rooming lists in Mecca and Medina, and delayed payment confirmations that lead to booking bottlenecks.

The challenge was to engineer an intuitive platform that:

  • Simplifies package publishing, tiered pricing, and quota monitoring
  • Automates pilgrim document collection (passports, yellow cards, biometric photos)
  • Eliminates payment reconciliation delays with instant gateway triggers

Objective

The key objectives for the UmrohApps ecosystem were:

  1. Create a multi-tenant SaaS architecture supporting branch offices and agent networks
  2. Deliver a fast, mobile-friendly booking and registration portal for prospective pilgrims
  3. Provide automated manifest generation compliant with Ministry of Religious Affairs (SISKOPATUH) standards
  4. Integrate real-time notification dispatch via automated WhatsApp and email

Approach

The development was carried out through an agile, user-centric process involving agency staff, muthowif leaders, and pilgrim feedback.

Research

Conducted on-site interviews with top pilgrimage travel operators to identify manifest generation bottlenecks and document loss points.

Design

Designed clear step-by-step registration flows, intuitive rooming matrices, and informative booking progress indicators.

Development

Engineered high-concurrency Laravel and React architecture with encrypted document vaults, automated PDF manifests, and payment webhooks.

Final Testing

Performed load testing during peak Hajj seasons, verifying accurate seat reservation locking and instant invoice generation under heavy traffic.

Solution

UmrohApps provides an all-in-one pilgrimage operations suite:

  • Interactive package catalog with real-time quota count and early-bird booking tiers
  • Dedicated self-service jamaah portal for easy document submission and itinerary tracking
  • One-click rooming list distribution for quad, triple, and double hotel occupancy in Saudi Arabia
  • Integrated payment gateway supporting Virtual Accounts, QRIS, and installment plans

Conclusion

UmrohApps transformed pilgrimage administration from a chaotic paper trail into a seamless digital journey. Participating agencies reported a 70% decrease in document processing time and significant enhancements in traveler satisfaction and trust.

Billing-WA.description_en: Automated WhatsApp billing and reminder platform designed for businesses and schools. Invoices are automatically sent, notifications dispatched, and payments tracked in real-time.
Billing-WA.bodyHtml:
Gambaran Umum

Billing WA adalah platform otomasi finansial yang memanfaatkan kekuatan aplikasi WhatsApp untuk mengirimkan rincian tagihan, invoice resmi berformat PDF, serta pengingat jatuh tempo secara terjadwal. Ditujukan bagi lembaga pendidikan, penyedia layanan langganan, pengelola iuran, serta UMKM, platform ini meniadakan kerepotan menagih manual dan mencatat mutasi rekening satu per satu.

Dengan menjangkau pelanggan di aplikasi perpesanan yang mereka gunakan setiap hari, Billing WA mengubah proses penagihan piutang menjadi pengalaman yang cepat, ramah, dan bebas friksi.

Permasalahan

Metode penagihan konvensional lewat email sering masuk spam atau tidak dibaca, sedangkan tagihan fisik maupun SMS kerap diabaikan. Menagih manual satu per satu lewat WhatsApp menyita waktu berjam-jam staf keuangan, rentan salah ketik nominal rekening, dan mustahil diskalakan saat jumlah pelanggan mencapai ratusan atau ribuan orang.

Permasalahan krusial yang diselesaikan:

  • Tingginya angka tunggakan akibat pelanggan lupa tanggal jatuh tempo pembayaran
  • Proses pencocokan manual antara bukti transfer bank dengan buku kas yang memakan waktu dan melelahkan
  • Kekhawatiran pemblokiran nomor telepon apabila melakukan broadcast massal tanpa integrasi API resmi

Tujuan Proyek

Sasaran utama dalam pengembangan Billing WA meliputi:

  1. Membangun mesin pengirim pesan otomatis yang terhubung resmi dengan WhatsApp Business API
  2. Mendukung impor data tagihan dan kontak pelanggan secara massal lewat file CSV / Excel
  3. Menghasilkan link pembayaran instan (QRIS & Virtual Account) yang disematkan langsung di dalam teks WhatsApp
  4. Menyediakan dasbor analitik real-time untuk memantau status pesan (Terkirim, Terbaca, Menunggu, Lunas)

Pendekatan Kerja

Kami menerapkan proses rekayasa berpusat pada kenyamanan pengguna (customer-first) dan keandalan pengiriman pesan.

Riset Perilaku

Mempelajari kebiasaan bertransaksi pelanggan Indonesia via WhatsApp guna menentukan waktu kirim notifikasi dan susunan kalimat penagihan paling efektif.

Desain UX & Invoice

Merancang format invoice digital PDF yang bersih dan profesional serta panel kontrol keuangan yang mudah dioperasikan staf bendahara.

Arsitektur Asinkron

Mengimplementasikan antrean pengiriman berkecepatan tinggi (queue workers) dengan mekanisme fallback agar broadcast tidak pernah macet.

Pengujian Rekonsiliasi

Menguji integrasi webhook gateway saat lonjakan transaksi serentak, memastikan notifikasi konfirmasi lunas dikirim instan dalam 2 detik.

Solusi yang Dihadirkan

Billing WA menghadirkan ekosistem penagihan otomatis yang menyeluruh:

  • Jadwal pengingat otomatis berjenjang (H-3 sebelum jatuh tempo, hari H, dan pesan follow-up ramah pasca jatuh tempo)
  • Pembuatan invoice resmi berformat PDF yang dilampirkan otomatis pada pesan WhatsApp yang dikirim
  • Integrasi payment gateway terpercaya (Virtual Account semua bank dan QRIS nasional tanpa upload bukti transfer)
  • Pengiriman kuitansi digital otomatis tanda terima pembayaran berhasil detik itu juga

Kesimpulan

Billing WA terbukti memangkas angka keterlambatan pembayaran hingga 78% pada institusi pendidikan dan pelaku usaha pengguna, sekaligus menyelamatkan ratusan jam produktivitas staf administrasi setiap bulannya dari pekerjaan menagih manual.

Billing-WA.bodyHtml_en:
Overview

Billing WA is an intelligent billing and invoice automation platform leveraging WhatsApp as the primary communication channel. Designed for educational institutions, subscription businesses, utilities, and service companies, it automates bill dispatch, sends scheduled payment nudges, and automatically reconciles incoming bank settlements.

By meeting customers where they are already active, Billing WA transforms accounts receivable into a modern, frictionless experience.

Problem

Traditional billing channels suffer from massive drop-offs: emails land in spam folders, postal mail arrives late, and SMS messages are frequently ignored. Manual WhatsApp collection, while effective, requires immense human labor, leads to typing errors, and is impossible to scale.

The core challenges included:

  • High delinquency rates caused by forgotten payment due dates
  • Laborious spreadsheet reconciliation between bank statements and billing ledgers
  • Risk of phone number blocking when broadcasting messages without official API protocols

Objective

The primary goals of Billing WA were:

  1. Build an automated dispatch engine integrated with official WhatsApp Business API endpoints
  2. Enable batch CSV/Excel customer imports with dynamic placeholder message templates
  3. Generate instant unique payment links (QRIS, VA) embedded directly within WhatsApp messages
  4. Provide a real-time analytics dashboard monitoring broadcast delivery, read rates, and collections

Approach

We applied a customer-first iterative engineering methodology centered around message deliverability and payment UX.

Research

Analyzed consumer payment habits on WhatsApp across Indonesian SMBs, identifying optimum message timing and copy formats.

Design

Crafted clean, accessible notification cards, readable PDF invoices, and a clutter-free financial dashboard for finance administrators.

Development

Constructed asynchronous job queues handling thousands of messages per minute with fallback channels and automated webhook triggers.

Final Testing

Tested webhook reconciliation under latency stress, guaranteeing instant receipt generation within seconds of payer bank transfer.

Solution

Billing WA delivers a robust receivables automation infrastructure:

  • Scheduled automated reminders sent 3 days before, on due date, and polite follow-ups for overdue payments
  • Dynamic PDF invoice creation attached automatically to outgoing WhatsApp notifications
  • Seamless integration with leading Indonesian payment gateways (Midtrans, Xendit, Tripay)
  • Instant automatic payment confirmation messages sent back to payer upon successful payment

Conclusion

Billing WA has delivered proven financial impact: client institutions experienced a 78% reduction in overdue receivables and recovered hundreds of staff hours previously spent on manual billing follow-ups.

Tujuan Proyek

Sasaran utama dalam pengembangan Billing WA meliputi:

  1. Membangun mesin pengirim pesan otomatis yang terhubung resmi dengan WhatsApp Business API
  2. Mendukung impor data tagihan dan kontak pelanggan secara massal lewat file CSV / Excel
  3. Menghasilkan link pembayaran instan (QRIS & Virtual Account) yang disematkan langsung di dalam teks WhatsApp
  4. Menyediakan dasbor analitik real-time untuk memantau status pesan (Terkirim, Terbaca, Menunggu, Lunas)

Pendekatan Kerja

Kami menerapkan proses rekayasa berpusat pada kenyamanan pengguna (customer-first) dan keandalan pengiriman pesan.

Riset Perilaku

Mempelajari kebiasaan bertransaksi pelanggan Indonesia via WhatsApp guna menentukan waktu kirim notifikasi dan susunan kalimat penagihan paling efektif.

Desain UX & Invoice

Merancang format invoice digital PDF yang bersih dan profesional serta panel kontrol keuangan yang mudah dioperasikan staf bendahara.

Arsitektur Asinkron

Mengimplementasikan antrean pengiriman berkecepatan tinggi (queue workers) dengan mekanisme fallback agar broadcast tidak pernah macet.

Pengujian Rekonsiliasi

Menguji integrasi webhook gateway saat lonjakan transaksi serentak, memastikan notifikasi konfirmasi lunas dikirim instan dalam 2 detik.

Solusi yang Dihadirkan

Billing WA menghadirkan ekosistem penagihan otomatis yang menyeluruh:

  • Jadwal pengingat otomatis berjenjang (H-3 sebelum jatuh tempo, hari H, dan pesan follow-up ramah pasca jatuh tempo)
  • Pembuatan invoice resmi berformat PDF yang dilampirkan otomatis pada pesan WhatsApp yang dikirim
  • Integrasi payment gateway terpercaya (Virtual Account semua bank dan QRIS nasional tanpa upload bukti transfer)
  • Pengiriman kuitansi digital otomatis tanda terima pembayaran berhasil detik itu juga

Kesimpulan

Billing WA terbukti memangkas angka keterlambatan pembayaran hingga 78% pada institusi pendidikan dan pelaku usaha pengguna, sekaligus menyelamatkan ratusan jam produktivitas staf administrasi setiap bulannya dari pekerjaan menagih manual.
billing-wa.bodyHtml_en:
Overview

Billing WA is an intelligent billing and invoice automation platform leveraging WhatsApp as the primary communication channel. Designed for educational institutions, subscription businesses, utilities, and service companies, it automates bill dispatch, sends scheduled payment nudges, and automatically reconciles incoming bank settlements.

By meeting customers where they are already active, Billing WA transforms accounts receivable into a modern, frictionless experience.

Problem

Traditional billing channels suffer from massive drop-offs: emails land in spam folders, postal mail arrives late, and SMS messages are frequently ignored. Manual WhatsApp collection, while effective, requires immense human labor, leads to typing errors, and is impossible to scale.

The core challenges included:

  • High delinquency rates caused by forgotten payment due dates
  • Laborious spreadsheet reconciliation between bank statements and billing ledgers
  • Risk of phone number blocking when broadcasting messages without official API protocols

Objective

The primary goals of Billing WA were:

  1. Build an automated dispatch engine integrated with official WhatsApp Business API endpoints
  2. Enable batch CSV/Excel customer imports with dynamic placeholder message templates
  3. Generate instant unique payment links (QRIS, VA) embedded directly within WhatsApp messages
  4. Provide a real-time analytics dashboard monitoring broadcast delivery, read rates, and collections

Approach

We applied a customer-first iterative engineering methodology centered around message deliverability and payment UX.

Research

Analyzed consumer payment habits on WhatsApp across Indonesian SMBs, identifying optimum message timing and copy formats.

Design

Crafted clean, accessible notification cards, readable PDF invoices, and a clutter-free financial dashboard for finance administrators.

Development

Constructed asynchronous job queues handling thousands of messages per minute with fallback channels and automated webhook triggers.

Final Testing

Tested webhook reconciliation under latency stress, guaranteeing instant receipt generation within seconds of payer bank transfer.

Solution

Billing WA delivers a robust receivables automation infrastructure:

  • Scheduled automated reminders sent 3 days before, on due date, and polite follow-ups for overdue payments
  • Dynamic PDF invoice creation attached automatically to outgoing WhatsApp notifications
  • Seamless integration with leading Indonesian payment gateways (Midtrans, Xendit, Tripay)
  • Instant automatic payment confirmation messages sent back to payer upon successful payment

Conclusion

Billing WA has delivered proven financial impact: client institutions experienced a 78% reduction in overdue receivables and recovered hundreds of staff hours previously spent on manual billing follow-ups.

web-porto.description_en: Modern personal portfolio website designed with sleek dark/light mode aesthetics, modular architecture, bilingual support, and high performance animations.

Gambaran Umum

Personal Portofolio adalah website portofolio interaktif tingkat lanjut yang dirancang khusus untuk menampilkan karya pengembangan web, keahlian UI/UX, dan kredensial sertifikasi resmi. Menggunakan teknologi Next.js 15, Framer Motion, dan Tailwind CSS, situs ini memadukan estetika visual berkelas, efek 3D tilt, transisi tema gelap/terang, dan lokalisasi dwibahasa (Indonesia & Inggris) yang mulus.

Setiap elemen dirancang dengan presisi untuk memberikan impresi profesional yang kuat kepada calon klien, mitra, maupun perekrut teknologi.

Permasalahan

Banyak website portofolio pengembang terkesan kaku, lambat saat dimuat, dan tidak memiliki narasi studi kasus yang menjelaskan proses pemecahan masalah di balik kode yang ditulis. Selain itu, keterbatasan dukungan multi-bahasa sering kali membatasi jangkauan audiens internasional.

Tantangan utama yang ingin diselesaikan:

  • Ketiadaan studi kasus mendalam yang mengulas latar belakang masalah, riset, dan arsitektur teknis proyek
  • Kendala animasi berat yang kerap memicu patah-patah (layout shift) pada perangkat ponsel
  • Kesulitan memperbarui data portofolio dan sertifikat secara dinamis tanpa harus mengubah kode berulang kali

Tujuan Proyek

Tujuan utama dari pembuatan Personal Portofolio ini adalah:

  1. Menciptakan pengalaman pengguna memikat dengan scroll reveal bertahap dan physics interaksi kartu 3D yang dinamis
  2. Menghadirkan fitur bilingual instan (Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris) dengan penyimpanan preferensi di peramban
  3. Mengimplementasikan arsitektur kode modular berbasis komponen yang bersih dan mudah dirawat
  4. Menghubungkan frontend Next.js dengan headless CMS API backend Laravel untuk manajemen data proyek secara real-time

Pendekatan Kerja

Pengembangan dilakukan dengan filosofi craftmanship tinggi, memadukan riset estetika dan rekayasa performa.

Riset Desain Global

Mengkaji ragam portofolio pemenang penghargaan di Awwwards dan Mobbin untuk mengadopsi standar tata letak, ritme tipografi, dan kontras warna terbaik.

Sistem Desain Craft

Menyusun token warna HSL adaptif, garis tepi halus, pola latar dot grid, dan komponen UI yang konsisten dalam mode terang maupun gelap.

Pengembangan Modular

Memprogram komponen reusable di Next.js App Router, Language Context Provider, dan animasi framer-motion yang efisien terhadap memori.

Audit Kinerja

Mengoptimasi Core Web Vitals hingga mencapai skor Lighthouse 95+, memastikan rendering instan tanpa jeda di Safari, Chrome, dan Android.

Solusi yang Dihadirkan

Personal Portofolio menghadirkan showcase digital kelas dunia:

  • Animasi kartu proyek interaktif dengan respon rotasi dinamis saat mouse diarahkan dan tombol tindakan langsung
  • Sistem pengalih bahasa ID/EN instan tanpa reload halaman yang mencakup landing page hingga seluruh studi kasus
  • Halaman detail proyek lengkap dengan tombol Kunjungi Situs, tangkapan layar antarmuka, serta rekomendasi karya terkait
  • Panel admin back-office untuk pembaruan profil, portofolio, sertifikat, dan pesan kontak masuk

Kesimpulan

Website portofolio ini mencerminkan dedikasi terhadap keunggulan visual dan kualitas rekayasa piranti lunak, menjadi sarana komunikasi profesional yang meyakinkan bagi calon kolaborator dan pemberi kerja potensial.

web-porto.bodyHtml_en:
Overview

Personal Portofolio is an immersive, high-performance developer and UI/UX portfolio website built to showcase digital products, certified credentials, and creative problem-solving. Engineered with Next.js 15, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS, the platform delivers a modern aesthetic with smooth micro-interactions, dark/light theme switching, and native bilingual capabilities.

The design balances aesthetic elegance with engineering precision, creating an interactive journey that captivates prospective clients and collaborators.

Problem

Many portfolio websites suffer from static presentation, sluggish load speeds, rigid language limitations, and disconnected CMS architectures that make keeping projects updated tedious and time-consuming.

The challenge was to construct a personal showcase that:

  • Delivers 60fps animations, 3D tilt effects, and scroll interactions without layout shifts
  • Supports instant bilingual switching (Indonesian and English) with persistent state
  • Connects seamlessly with a headless Laravel backend for dynamic project and certificate administration

Objective

Key objectives for the portfolio architecture:

  1. Build a highly modular component structure with clean separation of logic and presentation
  2. Implement accessible keyboard navigation and WCAG AA contrast standards across dark and light modes
  3. Provide in-depth project case study views that articulate challenges, methodologies, and business outcomes
  4. Ensure optimal Core Web Vitals with image format optimization and lazy loading

Approach

We applied a craft-oriented design system approach, iterating through typography scales, color palettes, and motion curves.

Research

Researched premier portfolio design awards (Awwwards, Godly, Mobbin) to distill leading typography, whitespace, and micro-interaction trends.

Design

Designed a cohesive design system using HSL color variables, sophisticated borders, dot grid backdrops, and balanced typography.

Development

Built reusable Next.js 15 App Router components, React Context bilingual provider, and Framer Motion spring physics.

Final Testing

Benchmarked across Safari, Chrome, iOS, and Android to guarantee smooth 60fps animations and perfect responsive layouts.

Solution

Personal Portofolio provides a world-class digital showcase:

  • Interactive scroll-bound 3D card physics with mouse-tracking perspective transforms
  • Complete Indonesian (ID) and English (EN) bilingual support with instant toggle and zero flash of untranslated content
  • Rich case study templates with live preview links, technical breakdowns, and related project suggestions
  • Full administrative panel back-office for managing portfolio items, skills, certificates, and inquiries

Conclusion

This portfolio stands as a testament to modern frontend capabilities, combining visual art and technical performance into an engaging digital calling card that builds immediate credibility with clients and engineering leaders.

hris-website.description_id: Sistem HRIS & Payroll komprehensif untuk perusahaan alih daya (outsourcing) dalam mengelola presensi GPS, mutasi kontrak kerja multi-klien, dan penggajian otomatis.
hris-website.description_en: Comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) designed for outsourcing agencies to manage attendance, employee contracts, payroll, and client assignments seamlessly.
hris-website.bodyHtml:
Gambaran Umum

HRIS Outsourcing adalah platform sistem informasi sumber daya manusia skala korporasi yang dibangun khusus menjawab kebutuhan bisnis penyedia jasa tenaga kerja alih daya. Sistem ini menghubungkan manajemen agensi, staf operasional di kantor cabang, perusahaan klien penempatan, serta ribuan karyawan lapangan dalam satu platform terpadu.

Dari pemantauan masa berlaku kontrak kerja PKWT, presensi mobile berbasis GPS radius geofencing, hingga perhitungan gaji dan lembur multi-komponen, platform ini menyederhanakan tata kelola ribuan tenaga kerja alih daya secara presisi.

Permasalahan

Perusahaan outsourcing mengelola ribuan pekerja dengan pola kerja yang sangat dinamis: aturan lembur yang berbeda-beda untuk tiap perusahaan klien, rotasi shift di berbagai lokasi cabang, maraknya manipulasi presensi (titip absen), serta risiko kelalaian memantau masa berlaku kontrak kerja karyawan.

Permasalahan operasional utama:

  • Rekapitulasi absensi kertas atau mesin finger konvensional yang memakan waktu berhari-hari saat periode gajian
  • Sulitnya memantau kehadiran staf di lokasi kerja klien yang tersebar di puluhan titik cabang
  • Risiko denda ketenagakerjaan jika perpanjangan atau pemutusan kontrak kerja terlambat diproses

Tujuan Proyek

Tujuan strategis dari implementasi HRIS Outsourcing:

  1. Menyediakan pusat data tunggal untuk mengelola penempatan karyawan, rotasi kerja, dan masa berlaku kontrak per klien
  2. Menerapkan absensi mobile berbasis GPS geofencing dan verifikasi swafoto (selfie) untuk mencegah presensi fiktif
  3. Mengotomasi kalkulasi payroll massal lengkap dengan potongan BPJS Kesehatan, BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, dan PPh 21
  4. Menyediakan portal akses khusus bagi perusahaan klien agar dapat memantau kehadiran dan menyetujui lembur secara transparan

Pendekatan Kerja

Pengembangan mematuhi standar arsitektur korporat yang ketat dalam hal privasi data, kontrol hak akses, dan audit trail.

Riset Operasional

Wawancara intensif dengan praktisi HRD dan manajer operasional di 5 perusahaan alih daya untuk memetakan formula gaji, tunjangan, dan regulasi PKWT.

Desain Antarmuka Ringkas

Merancang alur presensi mobile yang dapat diselesaikan dalam 5 detik serta dasbor rekapitulasi data yang ringkas bagi admin personalia.

Kalkulator Payroll Otomatis

Membangun mesin perhitungan gaji fleksibel dengan rumus kustom, ekspor file bulk transfer bank (BCA/Mandiri), dan rincian komponen tunjangan.

Simulasi Perhitungan Paralel

Menguji perhitungan gaji 3.000 karyawan secara paralel terhadap rekap manual historis, mencapai tingkat akurasi 100% tanpa selisih sepeser pun.

Solusi yang Dihadirkan

HRIS Outsourcing menghadirkan solusi menyeluruh pengelolaan tenaga kerja:

  • Presensi mobile cerdas dengan validasi radius lokasi GPS dan sensor anti fake-GPS untuk verifikasi akurat
  • Sistem pengingat masa habis kontrak kerja (notifikasi otomatis H-60 dan H-30 sebelum kontrak berakhir)
  • Pemrosesan payroll satu-klik yang memotong waktu rekap dari 5 hari kerja menjadi 2 jam
  • Distribusi slip gaji digital terenkripsi yang dapat diakses langsung oleh staf lapangan melalui smartphone

Kesimpulan

Implementasi HRIS Outsourcing berhasil mentransformasi tata kelola personalia alih daya menjadi terukur dan efisien. Agensi pengguna mampu mengelola lebih dari 3.000 tenaga kerja aktif dengan kepuasan klien yang tinggi serta nihil keluhan keterlambatan gaji.

hris-website.bodyHtml_en:
Overview

HRIS Outsourcing is an enterprise-grade human resource management and payroll platform tailored specifically for manpower outsourcing providers. The platform bridges client corporate accounts, agency dispatch coordinators, and thousands of field employees across distributed work sites.

From automated contract lifecycle reminders to GPS-geofenced mobile check-ins and complex multi-allowance payroll computation, HRIS Outsourcing simplifies large-scale workforce governance.

Problem

Outsourcing agencies face unique operational challenges that standard HR software fails to solve: multi-company employment rules, shifting contract durations across disparate clients, difficult ghost employee fraud prevention, and intricate wage calculations with varying client overtime rate agreements.

The platform needed to solve:

  • Manual paper-based timesheets leading to payroll disputes and delayed client billing
  • Lack of real-time visibility into staff attendance across remote client facilities
  • High risk of missed contract expirations resulting in statutory legal liabilities

Objective

The core goals of the system were:

  1. Centralize multi-client workforce roster and assignment tracking into a single command center
  2. Deploy mobile GPS attendance with biometric face verification to eliminate buddy punching
  3. Automate bulk payroll generation with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan/Kesehatan and PPh 21 tax compliance
  4. Provide a dedicated client portal where corporate partners can audit attendance and approve overtime

Approach

Development adhered to strict enterprise architecture standards focusing on data privacy, role authorization, and audit logs.

Research

Interviewed HR directors and field supervisors at 5 outsourcing firms to map complex contract, roster, and payroll rules.

Design

Created responsive web dashboards and mobile-first attendance screens designed for quick check-ins under spotty cellular connectivity.

Development

Engineered robust payroll computation engine with custom formula builders, bulk bank disbursement file export, and granular permissions.

Final Testing

Tested parallel payroll calculations against historical records for 3,000 employees, achieving 100% mathematical accuracy.

Solution

HRIS Outsourcing provides comprehensive manpower governance:

  • Geofenced mobile check-in with facial verification preventing proxy attendance
  • Automated contract milestone tracker alerting administrators 30 and 60 days before contract expiry
  • Automated end-of-month payroll computation cutting processing time from 5 days down to 2 hours
  • Self-service digital payslips delivered securely through mobile web and WhatsApp

Conclusion

HRIS Outsourcing empowered the agency to scale from 500 to over 3,000 contract personnel across diverse sectors without expanding their administrative headcount, establishing transparency and peace of mind for both workers and corporate clients.

lays-ecommerce-site.contentHtml:
Lay’s Wafer E-Commerce

An e-commerce project focused on user-friendly design, seamless shopping experience, and efficient product management.

Live Preview

Overview

Lay's Wafer e-commerce website is a modern online retail platform designed to showcase products, simplify discovery, and provide a frictionless shopping experience. The site combines vibrant product presentation with fast, accessible commerce flows to help customers find and purchase their favorite Lay's Wafer products.

The goal is to deliver a brand-forward storefront that balances visual storytelling with conversion-focused interactions across devices.

Problem

E-commerce for consumer goods faces several challenges: messy product discovery, inconsistent mobile experiences, and checkout friction that leads to abandoned carts.

The challenge was to design an online shopping experience that:

  • Highlights product variety and flavors clearly
  • Makes discovery and browsing fast and intuitive
  • Reduces friction at checkout to improve conversions

Objective

The primary objectives for this project were:

  1. Create a visually appealing and intuitive e-commerce storefront that reflects the Lay's Wafer brand identity
  2. Implement a fast, mobile-first browsing and checkout experience
  3. Integrate secure payment processing and reliable order management
  4. Provide easy product discovery, filtering, and search

Approach

The project followed a structured, iterative process focused on product presentation, usability, and reliable commerce integrations.

Research

just-website.contentHtml:
The Smarter Way to Market Your Business

Access everything you need to manage, automate, and optimize your marketing in one place, so you can focus on growing your business with confidence.

Live Preview

Overview

The Smarter Way to Market Your Business brings a unified marketing platform to companies seeking better control over their brand, campaigns, and performance. The product centralizes campaign management, automation, analytics, and creative assets, enabling teams to launch and optimize marketing faster and with more confidence.

This solution focuses on making marketing workflows simpler, reducing manual overhead, and improving measurable outcomes.

Problem

Marketing teams often face fragmented tools, manual processes, and unclear performance signals. This leads to slow campaign launches, inconsistent branding, and difficulty measuring ROI.

The challenge was to create a platform that:

  • Unifies campaign creation and automation
  • Centralizes assets and templates for consistent branding
  • Provides clear performance metrics and optimization guidance

Objective

The primary objectives were:

  1. Provide a central hub for campaign management and automation
  2. Make creative assets and templates easy to find and reuse
  3. Surface actionable performance insights to guide optimizations
  4. Reduce time-to-launch for marketing initiatives

Approach

The project followed an iterative design and development process focused on workflows, automation, and measurable performance.

Research

Reviewed marketing tool stacks, team workflows, and reporting needs to identify friction points and automation opportunities.

Design

Designed dashboard, campaign builders, and asset libraries to streamline creation and ensure consistent brand application.

Development

Built a responsive interface, campaign automation engine, and analytics pipeline to support reliable marketing operations.

Final Testing

Validated campaign workflows, automation triggers, and analytics accuracy across environments to ensure dependable operations.

Solution

The platform delivers:

  • A central campaign builder and automation engine for scheduled and triggered campaigns
  • An asset library with templates to speed creative production and enforce brand guidelines
  • Unified reporting and KPI dashboards for quick performance insights
  • Integrations with ad platforms and email providers to automate delivery and attribution

Together these features reduce manual work and help teams focus on strategy and creative impact.

Conclusion

This project showcases a consolidated marketing platform designed to empower teams to manage, automate, and optimize campaigns from a single interface. By simplifying workflows and surfacing actionable insights, teams can spend less time on coordination and more on growth.

astro-ai.description: AI-driven platform that helps client-facing businesses automate workflows, personalize interactions, and make smarter decisions using generative and predictive models.
astro-ai.contentHtml:
AI-Powered Solutions for Client-Facing Businesses

AI-driven platform that helps client-facing businesses automate workflows, personalize interactions, and make smarter decisions using generative and predictive models.

Live Preview

Overview

AI-Powered Solution for client-facing businesses. This platform empowers teams to automate repetitive work, personalize customer interactions at scale, and surface predictive insights that drive better outcomes.

Empowering learners and practitioners to shape the future: in today’s fast-paced world, staying ahead means taking bold steps to expand, innovate, and lead. We equip teams with strategies, insights, and tools to drive growth and turn business goals into measurable success.

The product also includes an interactive prompt interface for on-the-fly generation and prototyping: Enter your prompt → Generate.

Problem

Many client-facing businesses struggle with operational complexity: fragmented systems, high manual workload, and limited capacity to personalize at scale. Teams waste time on repetitive tasks and lack the insights needed to optimize service delivery.

The challenge was to build a platform that:

  • Automates routine tasks while remaining customizable
  • Enables scalable personalization across customer touchpoints
  • Provides clear, actionable analytics for decision-making

Objective

Primary objectives:

  1. Reduce manual workload through AI-assisted automation
  2. Enable fast experimentation and prototyping via prompts and generators
  3. Improve client outcomes by surfacing predictive recommendations
  4. Provide a single source of truth for performance and assets

Approach

We followed an iterative design and development process focused on usability, model reliability, and measurable impact.

Research

Studied client workflows, data availability, and common bottlenecks to identify automation opportunities and high-value use cases for AI.

Design

Architected intuitive interfaces and prompt-based tools to make AI capabilities accessible to non-technical users.

Development

Implemented model integration, data pipelines, and a responsive UI that supports real-time prompt generation and automated workflows.

Final Testing

Validated model outputs, safety filters, and analytics correctness; tested prompt flows and end-to-end automation for reliability.

Solution

The AI-powered platform provides:

  • Prompt-driven generators for content, responses, and creative variations
  • Automation pipelines that connect data, models, and delivery channels
  • Predictive analytics and recommendation widgets to prioritize actions
  • Safe-guards and auditing for model outputs to ensure trust and compliance

These capabilities allow client-facing teams to scale personalization, speed up delivery, and make decisions with confidence.

Conclusion

This project demonstrates an AI-first approach to supporting client-facing businesses: combining generative tools, automation, and analytics into a single platform that helps teams learn faster, act smarter, and deliver better results.

portfolio-website.contentHtml:
John Smith - Creative UI/UX Designer

Creative UI/UX Designer focused on user-centered interfaces, research-driven design, and engaging digital experiences.

Live Preview

Overview

Hello — I'm

John Smith

Creative UI/UX Designer

A UI/UX Designer focuses on creating user-friendly interfaces and optimizing the overall user experience by understanding user needs and behaviors. I combine visual design skills with research and testing to ensure that digital products are both functional and engaging.

Let's work together — I help teams turn ideas into intuitive, polished products that users love.

Problem

Design teams often face unclear requirements, limited user insights, and competing stakeholder priorities. These challenges can lead to interfaces that are hard to use or fail to meet user needs.

The challenge is to balance aesthetics with usability, and to validate design decisions with research and testing.

Objective

The primary objectives for this portfolio are:

  1. Showcase selected UI/UX work that demonstrates process and outcomes
  2. Communicate design thinking, research, and measurable impact
  3. Provide a clear way to get in touch — Let's Work Together

Approach

I follow a research-driven, iterative design process that includes user research, low/hi-fidelity prototyping, usability testing, and handoff-ready design assets.

Research

Conducted user interviews, competitive analysis, and usability testing to uncover needs and opportunities.

Design

Created wireframes, interaction patterns, and visual systems focused on clarity, accessibility, and delight.

Prototyping

Built interactive prototypes to validate flows and gather user feedback before final implementation.

Handoff & Testing

Performed usability testing, iterated on designs, and prepared documentation and assets for engineering handoff.

Selected case studies showcase the end-to-end process: research insights, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and measurable outcomes (engagement, conversion, or usability improvements).

I deliver polished UI assets, interaction specifications, and collaborative design handoffs that reduce implementation friction.

Conclusion

If you'd like to collaborate or discuss a project, reach out — Let's Work Together. This project demonstrates an AI-first approach to supporting client-facing businesses: combining generative tools, automation, and analytics into a single platform that helps teams learn faster, act smarter, and deliver better results.

matter-lading-page.title: Crafting Matter Robotic Intelligence
matter-lading-page.description: A robotics project focused on intelligent systems, precision engineering, and real-world problem solving.
matter-lading-page.contentHtml:
Crafting Matter Robotic Intelligence

A robotics project focused on intelligent systems, precision engineering, and real-world problem solving.

Live Preview

Overview

Matter is a project centered on designing and developing intelligent systems that interact meaningfully with the physical world. It explores how robotics, control logic, and thoughtful design can come together to create responsive, efficient, and purposeful machines.

The focus is not only on technical capability, but on building systems that behave reliably in real-world environments while remaining simple and intuitive to interact with.

Problem

Modern robotic systems often struggle to balance intelligence, reliability, and usability. Many existing solutions focus heavily on technical performance while overlooking adaptability, clarity of interaction, and real-world constraints.

The challenge was to design a robotic system that:

  • Demonstrates intelligent behavior
  • Responds accurately to environmental inputs
  • Maintains simplicity in both design and interaction

Objective

The goal of Matter was to create a robotic intelligence system that:

  • Processes inputs efficiently
  • Makes logical decisions in real time
  • Integrates hardware and software seamlessly
  • Prioritizes functionality without sacrificing design clarity

Approach

The project followed a structured, iterative process to ensure both technical rigor and design clarity.

Research

Analyzed existing robotics systems, control architectures, and intelligent behaviors to identify design gaps and technical opportunities.

Design

Defined system architecture, interaction flows, and component structure to ensure clarity, efficiency, and scalability.

Development

Built and integrated hardware and software components, control logic, and intelligent behaviors through iterative prototyping.

Final Testing

Evaluated system performance, accuracy, and responsiveness. Refined behaviors to ensure stability and reliability in real-world conditions.

Solution

Matter delivers a robotic system capable of:

  • Interpreting sensory data in real time
  • Making autonomous decisions based on defined logic
  • Executing precise physical actions
  • Adapting consistently to changing inputs

The result is a cohesive robotic intelligence model that feels purposeful, responsive, and scalable.

Conclusion

Matter represents an exploration into intelligent robotics where engineering, logic, and design intersect. The project demonstrates how deliberate system design and iterative development can result in robotic intelligence that is both functional and meaningful in real-world applications.

grow-lading-page.contentHtml:
Grow - Marketing Agency

A full-service marketing agency website showcasing brand strategy, performance marketing, and conversion-driven design that delivers measurable results.

Live Preview

Overview

Grow is a full-service marketing agency specializing in brand strategy, content creation, performance marketing, and conversion-driven design. We help businesses amplify their message, reach their target audience, and achieve measurable growth through strategic campaigns and creative solutions.

Our approach combines data-driven insights with compelling storytelling to create marketing experiences that resonate with audiences and drive real business results.

Problem

Many businesses struggle to stand out in crowded digital landscapes. Traditional marketing approaches often fail to connect with modern audiences, resulting in wasted ad spend, low engagement, and missed opportunities for growth.

The challenge was to create a marketing agency platform that:

  • Showcases expertise in brand strategy and digital marketing
  • Demonstrates proven results and client success stories
  • Communicates services clearly and compellingly

Objective

The goal of Grow was to create a marketing agency website that:

  • Establishes credibility and showcases expertise
  • Clearly communicates service offerings and value propositions
  • Drives lead generation through strategic CTAs
  • Reflects modern design trends while maintaining conversion focus

Approach

The project followed a structured, iterative process to ensure both technical rigor and design clarity.

Research

Analyzed competitor agencies, market positioning, and audience behaviors to identify opportunities for differentiation and brand messaging.

Design

Created compelling visual identity, user flows, and conversion-optimized layouts that reflect agency expertise and professionalism.

Development

Built responsive website with modern tech stack, integrated contact forms, case study showcases, and performance tracking.

Final Testing

Tested conversion flows, page load performance, and cross-device compatibility to ensure optimal user experience and lead generation.

Solution

Grow delivers a comprehensive marketing agency website featuring:

  • Clear service offerings spanning brand strategy to performance marketing
  • Compelling case studies showcasing measurable client results
  • Strategic CTAs and lead capture optimized for conversion
  • Modern, professional design that builds trust and credibility

The result is a digital presence that positions Grow as a strategic partner for businesses seeking growth through marketing excellence.

Conclusion

Grow represents a modern approach to marketing agency web presence where strategy, design, and conversion optimization intersect. The project demonstrates how thoughtful UX design and clear messaging can effectively communicate expertise and drive business growth through digital channels.
